text: At its meeting on November 25, 2019, the Board delegated to the Chair the recruitment process for the position of President, Toronto Parking Authority, and requested that the Chair update the Board on the process as needed. This item would be that update.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Requested the Chair, Toronto Parking Authority, to provide an update to the Board during its meeting on July 24, 2020 regarding the Toronto Parking Authority President search process.
